description:
Built around our six-time World Championship-winning Quartz frame, the Quartz Pro represents the pinnacle of our BMX race range. This super-lightweight alloy chassis is paired with a no-compromise Pro-level specification, bringing together the very best components we've developed to create a bike built for one thing—winning races.
Featuring our Quartz Pro fork, Argon rims, Bravo hubs, and the latest hydraulic disc brake system, the Quartz Pro delivers elite-level performance straight out of the box. Fast, responsive, and race-proven, it's a bike designed for riders chasing podium finishes.
The latest Quartz Disc frame introduces sliding disc dropouts with flat-mount brake compatibility, alongside clean internal cable routing for a refined, race-focused finish. Developed through championship success and engineered for modern BMX racing, the Quartz Pro is ready to perform when it matters most.

FRAME: RADIO RACELINE "QUARTZ DISC" frame, lightweight hydroformed 6061-T6 alloy, tapered headtube, sliding forged dropouts, with int. chaintensioners, flatmount disc brake

FORK: ARISE "QUARTZ PRO" fork, 1-1/8" - 1.5" tapered steerer, 31mm offset, inc. 10mm adaptors

STEM: ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy

components.description: RADIO RACELINE "BSA24" bb set, external bearing cups, cnc machined, sealed
ARISE "XENON" hydraulic disc brake, 120mm rotor, rear, flatmount
ARISE "XENON PRO" 2pc crank, cold forged/cnc, alloy, 175mm length, 24mm spindle
ARISE "QUARTZ PRO" fork, 1-1/8" - 1.5" tapered steerer, 31mm offset, inc. 10mm adaptors
RADIO RACELINE "XENON" grips, diamond knurling, clamp on grip, 139mm length
RADIO RACELINE "NEON PRO 7.5" hydroformed bar, multiple butted & heattreated crmo
RADIO RACELINE "PRO" integrated headset, sealed, threadless, 1-1/8" - 1.5"
ARISE "BRAVO" front hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, 3/8" female crmo axle
ARISE "BRAVO" rear hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, disc brake cassette, 6 pawl, 3/8" female crmo axle
ARISE "ARGON PRO" rim, flash welded, 32 / 36h, tubeless ready, alloy
ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy
TIOGA "FASTR" tires, front: 20" x 1.75" and rear: 20" x 1.6"
